audience: tour, rental and event operators that collect signed waivers with Otter Waiver

useCases.title: List the waivers and their status
useCases.text: List the waivers of the account and filter by event name or title. See which waivers are in draft, active or inactive.

useCases.title: Read the full text of a waiver
useCases.text: Open one waiver to read its full text, settings and extra fields. Check the wording before an event.

useCases.title: See who signed in the last days
useCases.text: List the 50 latest participants who signed a waiver, with the sign times. Open one participant to read the details.

useCases.title: Review the latest check-ins
useCases.text: List the 50 latest check-ins to see who arrived at today's activity.
